deleteOrchestratorHint: Remove this coordinator and stop its sessions. Delivery tasks remain on the board.
name: Name
noCoordinatedTasks: No tasks yet. Open the conversation to delegate work or ask the orchestrator to adopt an existing task.
noOrchestrators: No orchestrators yet. Add one to coordinate this workspace.

orchestratorProfileHint: This profile runs the coordinator. Delivery tasks use their own profiles, which you can change independently.

roleAssignmentHint: Name, icon and instructions come from the global role. Role changes apply to every workspace using it on the next turn.
coordinatorHint: Keep workspace tasks and your coordinator conversation together.
selectCoordinatorHint: Choose a coordinator to open its conversation.

profileUnavailable: The selected agent profile or execution environment is unavailable. Update this coordinator’s configuration to continue.
conversationUnavailable: The conversation is unavailable. Check the coordinator configuration and try again.
partialCoverage: Counts describe loaded tasks. Load more to include remaining matches.
staleTasks: Task data may be out of date. Refresh to try again.
